question: Can every byte of the failed source qualification be retained under a registered archive without relabeling the failed analysis as successful?
decision: Preserve failure evidence with separate archival provenance; original local bytes and original commit remain.
strongest_rival: Registering a failed analysis as successful or deleting failed evidence would obscure source correction history.
discriminator: Byte-for-byte copies, original paths and SHA256 values, with explicit execution_failed status retained.
exposure_record: Final paper outcomes and Figure5 panels have been read; source metadata and headers inspected before freeze. No new matrix group outcome contrasts inspected. This exposed metadata stage does not establish unexposed confirmation.
biological_unit: Not applicable to deterministic archive; original biological-unit uncertainty remains unchanged.
nesting_and_overlap: Exact duplicate evidence only, not replication or a new scientific observation.
population_and_selection: Exactly four files from the failed sx10_qualification_v1 run; no biological selection.
contrast: Original versus archived byte hashes only; no biological contrast.
endpoint: Exact archived failed receipt, partial crosswalk and logs, plus preservation manifest.
methods: Copy four declared immutable inputs to exclusively created outputs, retain execution_failed status, record original paths and hashes.
missingness_and_exclusions: Preserve all files present in the failed attempt; missing expected analysis outputs remain missing.
multiplicity: Not applicable to deterministic copying; no inferential testing.
precision_basis: No effect estimate or biological precision in archival metadata.
interpretation_limit: Archive execution success means copying only; the original source qualification remains failed. No scientific acceptance or population inference.
stop_rule: Stop on hash mismatch, existing destination, missing source file or original status not execution_failed.
amendment_reason: Use the existing Nb5/DY1 failed-run preservation pattern because the unchanged registry accepts only successful execution receipts. Original files remain local and in commit ea6267a; duplicate index entries will be retired after archive verification.
